items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 8:35 a.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
Recess and Reconvene
notes: The Special Council meeting then recessed at 8:35 a.m. and reconvened at 8:42 a.m, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic with all members present, save and except for Councillor D. Chapman.

items.title: To confirm all actions and proceedings of the Council for April 24, 2025.
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 8:45 a.m.

motions.text: "That the CAO, or the General Manager of Development Services be authorized to execute agreements with municipalities in Ontario requiring the provision of Building Code Act related services under the Building Code Act, 1992 for a limited period of time provided Kitchener’s Chief Building Official determines that Kitchener has the capacity to provide such services; said agreements to be to the satisfaction of the City Solicitor."
motions.text_html: "That the CAO, or the General Manager of Development Services be authorized to execute agreements with municipalities in Ontario requiring the provision of Building Code Act related services under the Building Code Act, 1992 for a limited period of time provided Kitchener’s Chief Building Official determines that Kitchener has the capacity to provide such services; said agreements to be to the satisfaction of the City Solicitor."

motions.text: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider a labour relations matter as authorized by Sections 239 (d) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."
motions.text_html: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider a labour relations matter as authorized by Sections 239 (d) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."

motions.text: "That the terms and conditions contained in the Memorandum of Settlement dated April 10, 2025, to establish the 2025-2029 Collective Agreement with CUPE 791 be approved; and, That the CUPE 791 terms and conditions contained in the Memorandum of Settlement dated April 10, 2025 be extended to non-union staff with part-time/casual staff receiving wage adjustment only; and further, That the Mayor and the Clerk be authorized to execute documentation arising there from."

"That the terms and conditions contained in the Memorandum of Settlement dated April 10, 2025, to establish the 2025-2029 Collective Agreement with CUPE 791 be approved; and,
